risks.title: Economic Risk and Cyclicality of the Agricultural Industry
risks.summary: The company is exposed to economic risks related to the agricultural industry, which can be affected by fluctuations in commodity prices, changes in government policies, and general macroeconomic conditions.
risks.score_rationale: The company is entirely dependent on the agricultural industry, which is cyclical and sensitive to economic factors. Revenues are affected by farm income, commodity prices, weather conditions, and government policies. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Risk of Intensified Competition
risks.summary: The company faces increased competition in the agricultural equipment market, which may affect its sales volumes, revenue, and profit margins.
risks.score_rationale: The company faces significant competition in the agricultural equipment market, notably from Deere Company and CNH. Competitive pressures may affect sales volumes and margins. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Risk of Tariffs and Trade Policy
risks.summary: Changes in trade policies and tariffs directly impact supply costs and selling prices, with ongoing uncertainty regarding final tariff structures and risks of retaliation.
risks.score_rationale: Recent announcements of significant tariff policies create substantial uncertainty. Tariffs on steel, aluminum, and imports from China, Canada, and Mexico increase manufacturing costs. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Risk of Financing and Dependence on Third Parties
risks.summary: The company faces risks related to financing, particularly due to reliance on loans and guarantees for product sales through its financing partnerships.
risks.score_rationale: The company is highly dependent on financing for product sales through its joint financing ventures with Rabobank. Difficulties in accessing financing could affect dealer and customer sales. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Geopolitical Risk and Trade Tensions
risks.summary: Conflicts and geopolitical tensions may negatively impact the company's sales and profits, particularly due to reduced demand and risks of trade retaliation.
risks.score_rationale: Conflicts and geopolitical tensions may affect sales and profits, particularly due to market access and potential tariff retaliations. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Environmental Regulation and Compliance Risk
risks.summary: The company faces risks related to environmental regulation and compliance in the various countries where it operates, which may require significant investments.
risks.score_rationale: The company must comply with regulations and laws in different jurisdictions, including evolving emissions standards and environmental requirements. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Foreign Exchange Risk and Currency Volatility
risks.summary: Fluctuations in exchange rates may have a material negative impact on the company's sales and profits, with particularly significant effects on international operations.
risks.score_rationale: Exchange rate fluctuations create volatility for consolidated results. In 2025, foreign exchange losses reached $81.9M. (default score, to be refined)

ai_positioning.summary: AGCO integrates technologies such as AI into its operations and products, notably through initiatives like OneAg. The company also mentions technology and patent-related assets, suggesting AI use to enhance its precision agriculture solutions.
